public_note: The parent survey was administered in five languages (English, Bulgarian, Catalonian, Greek, Romanian); only the English master questionnaire is published in the study's S1 File, so the item text shown here is the wording read by 157 of the 306 respondents and an English equivalent of what the other 149 read. The survey's response options are printed positive-pole-first in that questionnaire, but the stored coding runs the other way: resp 5 is the first-printed (most positive/most frequent) option and resp 1 the last.
